question: Why can a full infinite hotel always fit infinitely many more guests, when no list can ever hold every infinite sequence of 0s and 1s?
finding: Cantor's pairing rule houses infinitely many coachloads in the full hotel with no room shared or empty (room 100 goes to seat 9 of coach 5), but even the list of every repeating binary pattern misses a sequence, beginning 1010 0011 1110, that differs from row k at digit k.
limit: The page can only draw and check finite windows of infinite objects; the theorems rest on the arguments, and on accepting completed infinite sets, not on anything computed here.
